headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 16, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies continued their winning streak with an 8-2 victory over the Miami Marlins, led by Jesús Luzardo's strong performance on the mound. In other action, the Toronto Blue Jays took down the Boston Red Sox 6-1, while the New York Yankees dominated the Chicago White Sox 12-2.

Several teams suffered injuries, including the Seattle Mariners, who placed third baseman Will Wilson on the 60-day injured list due to an undisclosed reason. The Mariners also placed left fielder Randy Arozarena on the 10-day injured list with a left hamstring strain. The Philadelphia Phillies placed right-handed pitcher Brad Keller on the 15-day injured list with right forearm tendinitis.

The Kansas City Royals made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for right-hander Denis Samudio and cash.

top_news.title: **Phillies Cruise Past Marlins in 8-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Miami Marlins, securing an 8-2 win. Jesús Luzardo led the way for the Phillies, pitching 7.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall Short in Nation's Capital**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals dropped a 4-6 decision to the Washington Nationals, unable to overcome a strong performance from the Nationals' offense. Curtis Mead led the way for the Nationals with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Red Sox 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 6-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, led by George Springer's impressive performance at the plate. Springer hit a home run (7) and drove in 3 runs, while Dylan Cease pitched 5 strong innings with 7 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Rout White Sox 12-2**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees dominated the Chicago White Sox, securing a 12-2 victory. José Caballero led the White Sox offense with 2 hits, including his 7th home run of the season.

top_news.title: **Mariners Place Will Wilson on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners have made a roster move, placing third baseman Will Wilson on the 60-day injured list. This change is effective as of June 16, 2026.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Seabold in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their roster, acquiring right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for right-hander Denis Samudio and cash.
